title: Terminal gauge snap (the r1 game-over-freeze fix) has zero coverage — deleting it passes every gate
detail: This r1 review fix ships unpinned: it lives inline in main's fixed-timestep loop, unreachable by the pullback-style wiring tests. Deleting the call returns the frozen mid-ease lose-screen fill with every gate green.
recommended_fix: Extract the terminal transition (mode set + gauge_reset) into a seam proc like start_run/feed_drop_sites and pin it with the same pullback_test_app fixture: arm a mid-ease state, drive the proc, expect gauges unseeded.

title: SLA eased display numbers lack the draw-path mutation leg — bypassing gauge_read in draw_sla_gauges fails no test
detail: The briefing's non-negotiable standard ("deleting/bypassing the easing MUST fail a test") holds for health and pool bars but not the SLA readouts: deleting either gauge_read call keeps unit, wiring, golden, and palcheck gates green — the strobe silently returns.
recommended_fix: Pin the SLA draw seam: move the eased-readout formatting into app/render (harness-importable) and palcheck it, or export the display-number derivation and pin it from the existing app-package test; record the deferral in deferred-work.md as claimed.

title: Pool-bar chunk-ghost draw block unpinned — health twin has palcheck 6(c) legs, pool has none
detail: Deleting the pool ghost block (visibility.odin:110-120) fails no test: gauge_flash_read is unit-tested generically, and palcheck 6(e) never renders a chunk state. One of the two flash cues is mutation-survivable at the draw level.
recommended_fix: Add a 6(e) chunk leg mirroring 6(c): gauge_reset, seed 100, chunk to 20 via gauge_target, render at age 1 — scan the ghost band blends over the track, then pure track after len(CHUNK_FLASH) ticks.

title: CHUNK_SLA_MS per-unit threshold wiring never exercised by any test
evidence:
app/render/gauge.odin:282:
            gauge_target(v, &v.gauges.sla_ms[c], sla_avg_ms(acc), tick, CHUNK_SLA_MS)
— `grep -rn CHUNK_SLA_MS app/ harness/ --include='*.odin' | grep -v '^app/render/gauge.odin'` → 0 hits: no test anywhere references CHUNK_SLA_MS. Every gauge_target call in gauge_test.odin (lines 84-296) passes CHUNK_PCT; gauge_tick tests (gauge_sla_slots_seed_lazily, gauge_tick_feeds_all_gauges) feed only small SLA deltas, never a ≥25ms chunk crossing.
detail: The r1 per-unit-threshold fix (CHUNK_PCT vs CHUNK_SLA_MS — itself a review finding) ships unregression-pinned: swapping CHUNK_SLA_MS to CHUNK_PCT in gauge_tick, or reintroducing the unit confusion, fails nothing.
recommended_fix: Add a gauge_tick test: seed sla_ms at 10ms, jump total_latency_ms so avg ≥ 35ms, assert the tween re-anchored (start moved from display, t0 = jump tick) while sla_loss stays on its pct threshold.

title: Loop→feed_drop_sites call site unpinned and the claimed deferred-work.md entries are absent
evidence:
app/main.odin:580 (inside main's fixed-timestep step loop):
                feed_drop_sites(&app)
— app/gauge_wiring_test.odin:70 drives the seam proc directly (`feed_drop_sites(&app)`), not the loop's call of it. The PR body claims "Deferred (deferred-work.md): the loop→feed_drop_sites call-site pin (the pre-existing debug_surface_smoke.sh class — needs a headless app-drive harness)" but deferred-work.md contains no such entry (its 8 lines hold only the lane-qos and routing-bandwidth items). tools/debug_surface_smoke.sh runs `./bin/harness-debug-sw overlay-pixels qos_contention 12000ms` — a harness overlay path, not the app loop.
detail: Deleting main.odin:580 disables the entire gauge feed (and drop marks) with every gate green — the seam is pinned one level down, but the engagement call is not, and the deferral is not durably recorded where claimed.
recommended_fix: Record both gauge deferrals in _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md now; land the headless app-drive harness story that can pin the loop call site (same class as debug_surface_smoke).

title: pool_fill_pct boundary clamps (packets > cap, cap ≤ 0) untested
detail: The shared derivation now owns the off-frame guard, but its two boundary behaviors (overflow clamp, degenerate cap) have no regression test — a future refactor of the clamp or guard fails nothing.
recommended_fix: Extend gauge_tick_feeds_all_gauges (or a small unit test): 150 packets / cap 100 → target exactly 100; cap 0 → no divide-by-zero, pct bounded 0..100.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: Pinned: app/render/gauge_test.odin (11 tests) + app/gauge_wiring_test.odin (2 tests) + palcheck section 6 (health legs a-d + pool legs e unfed/mid-ease) — gauge_wiring_test.odin:4 self-describes the class: "pins (the r1 verification-gap findings — the repo's #1 blocker genus: 'a wiring regression that never draws would pass every compile gate and every golden')". Unpinned (verified above): terminal snap (app/main.odin:617, 0 test refs), SLA draw seam (app/main.odin:2279/2289, no palcheck leg), pool ghost (visibility.odin:110, no 6e leg), CHUNK_SLA_MS wiring (gauge.odin:282, 0 test refs), pool_fill_pct boundaries (gauge.odin:241).
detail: P0 (golden byte-identity/unfed contract) 100% — unit + draw-level + goldens. P1 ≈80%: the three named surfaces' draw legs and both reset paths, with SLA draw and terminal snap unpinned. Overall ≈83% (20/24 behavior rows full/half-credit).
recommended_fix: Raise P1 to ≥90%: extract+pin the terminal transition, add the SLA eased-readout draw-path leg, and a pool-ghost palcheck leg; record the two deferrals in deferred-work.md as the PR body claims.
